literal: Having seen the form, not despising is needed; to the rolling large chariot, people like the axle-pin it possesses.
translation: Do not underestimate anyone based on their appearance. The world possesses people who are as crucial as the small linchpin to a massive, rolling chariot.
modern: ஒருவரின் தோற்றத்தைக் கண்டு அவரைச் சாதாரணமாக எண்ணி இகழக்கூடாது. உருண்டோடும் பெரிய தேருக்குச் சிறிய அச்சாணி எவ்வளவு முக்கியமோ, அதுபோன்ற ஆற்றல் உடையவர்கள் இவ்வுலகில் உள்ளனர்.
explanation: This couplet warns against judging a person's capability by their physical appearance. A chariot may be massive and impressive as it rolls along, but its movement depends entirely on a small linchpin holding the axle together. Similarly, people who appear small or unassuming may possess the crucial strength and firmness of action needed to sustain great enterprises. The word 'அச்சாணி' (linchpin) perfectly captures how immense power and stability can reside in a small, unpretentious form.
